content: उच्च {%a.%} .²1 High (in all senses); tall; क्षितिधारणोच्चं <ls>Ku. 7. 63</ls>; elevated, superior, exalted (family <ab>&c.</ab>) .²2 Loud, high-sounding; उच्चाः पक्षिगणाः <ls>Śi. 4. 18</ls>. .²3 Intense, violent, strong. .²4 (In <ab>astr.</ab>) Ascendant; see उच्चसंश्रय below. .{@-च्चः@} .²1 The apex of the orbit of a planet. .²2 Height, high place; ज्वरश्च मरणं जन्तोरुच्चाच्च पतनं यथा <ls>Mb. 12. 28. 25</ls>.
